news_vs_analysis: Analysis-leaning mix. Raw empirical signals come from registries/APIs (BMRS, ENTSO-E, LCCC, LBNL, NESO) and data houses (Modo Energy, EnAppSys, Energy-Charts, Ember); first-principles analysis from independent blogs and think tanks (Timera Energy, Watt-Logic, OIES, RAP, Grid Strategies) and journals (Energy Economics, Nature Energy); high-density news from trade press (Montel, Current News, reNEWS, Carbon Pulse, PV Magazine, Hydrogen Insight) and newsletters (Grid Brief, Volts); podcasts (Modo 'Transmission', Energy Gang, Redefining Energy, Energy Unplugged, Cleaning Up, Volts) add narrative context and expert interviews.
notes: All 5 round-1 reviewer findings addressed: (1) Redefining Energy domain corrected to redefining-energy.com — verified live (site serves the podcast; weekly episodes). (2) New dedicated 'Interconnectors (cross-border capacity & markets)' subarea added with 3 sources: Ofgem cap-and-floor regime (crawl root pinned to the verified Interconnector Policy Review decision), ENTSO-E Transparency physical flows API, and Current News trade-press project coverage (Viking Link, NeuConnect). (3) DESNZ crawl root pinned to gov.uk/government/organisations/department-for-energy-security-and-net-zero (verified resolving, incl. atom feed); Energy Trends, DUKES and CfD AR results named as entry datasets. (4) The Energy Gang pinned to its dedicated podcast hub woodmac.com/podcasts/energy-gang/ with RSS feed at rss.art19.com/the-energy-gang (both verified this round); note theenergygang.com does NOT resolve, so the pinned hub + Art19 feed is the correct crawler entry, mirroring the Energy Unplugged/Aurora pattern. (5) Publisher-level exclusion confirmed as NOT intended: per the engine spec the blacklist is domain-level (known_domains), so Solar Media titles (Energy-Storage.news, PV Tech, Current News) are retained; their content scope (storage, solar tech, networks) is distinct from the blacklisted Solar Power Portal, and none of the 6 exclude_domains or 4 subscribed sources appear. Round-2 hardening: crawl_root pinned on every broad-portal domain — gov.uk (DESNZ), sciencedirect.com (Energy Economics), nature.com (Nature Energy), eia.gov (electricity portal), iea.org (electricity topic), rmi.org (Electricity program) and the Ofgem interconnector decision page; podcasts now use dedicated feeds/hubs rather than corporate roots. Boundaries respected: no consumer-EV, efficiency-gadget, corporate-sustainability-PR or climate-activism outlets; Sandbag included only for ETS data/analysis tools, not advocacy. Verification this round: redefining-energy.com, rss.art19.com/the-energy-gang, gov.uk DESNZ org page, eia.gov/electricity, rmi.org/our-work/electricity and ofgem.gov.uk interconnector decision URL all confirmed live; round-1 confirmations retained (10 domains via web_search, 4 via direct reads).
